```{r Setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)

# --- Paden Definitie ---
path_data_lw          <- "../../../../Aangeleverd/20260410_WL_DD_LW_HW/Statistics HW LW 4QNplusQE.xlsx"
path_percentielen_lw  <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Getij/verwerking/FrequentieHW&LW/outputHWLW/percentielen_HWLW_alle_2017_2020.csv"
path_percentielen_zijrivieren <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/zijrivieren_data/percentielen_hwlw_zijrivieren_extra.csv"

path_tijposten_csv    <- "../../Data/Kalibratie/input/tijposten.csv"
path_tijposten_csv2   <- "../../Data/Kalibratie/input/extra_tijposten_Waterinfo.csv"
path_salzone_shp      <- "../../../../../GIS_Zeeschelde/Referentiedata/gebiedsindelingen/ScheldevalleiSalZone_KRW_OMES_2022.shp"
path_alloc_gdb        <- "../../../../../Ecotoop/Fysiotoop/BASIS_Ecotopen_GETIJ_ETRS.gdb"

output_dir <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/"
output_fig <- "../../Output/Kalibratie/figuren_LW30/"
```



```{r inladen modeldata}
data_long_lw <- read_excel(path_data_lw, sheet = 1) %>%
  rename(LW_raw = 1) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_remove(str_remove(str_trim(.), "^LW "), " %$"))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  # Selectie van de gewenste model-percentielen
  filter(LW_raw %in% c(0, 5, 10, 20, 30)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(LW_raw), names_to = "AllocNR", values_to = "waterstand_WL") %>%
  mutate(AllocNR = as.character(as.integer(str_remove(AllocNR, "INBOpt_"))))
```


```{r inladen tijpostdata}
tijpost_raw <- rbind(
  read.csv(path_tijposten_csv),
  read.csv2(path_tijposten_csv2)) %>%
  mutate(tijpost = if_else(tijpost == "Wintam Sluis", "Wintam Sluis Afwaarts", tijpost))

sf_zones <- st_read(path_salzone_shp, quiet = TRUE)
sf_alloc <- st_read(dsn = path_alloc_gdb, layer = "AllocatieAspntScheldeRupelbekkenETRS", quiet = TRUE) %>% 
  select(AllocNR, Dist)

sf_data_clean <- st_as_sf(tijpost_raw, coords = c("x_lambert72", "y_lambert72"), crs = 31370) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(sf_zones)) %>%
  st_join(sf_zones %>% select(SalZone)) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(sf_alloc)) %>%
  st_join(sf_alloc) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    SalZone = case_match(SalZone, 
                         c("Mesohalien", "Zone met sterke saliniteitsgradiënt") ~ "brak", .default = "zoet"),
    AllocNR = as.character(as.integer(AllocNR))) %>%
  distinct(tijpost, .keep_all = TRUE)

```



```{r inladen HIC data}
df_hic_raw <- read.csv(path_percentielen_lw, sep=";") %>%
  filter(fase == "LW")

zijrivieren <- read.csv2(path_percentielen_zijrivieren, sep= ";") %>%
  filter(fase == "LW")  

df_hic_raw <- rbind(df_hic_raw, zijrivieren)

rivier_groepen <- list(
  "Zeeschelde" = "Zeeschelde",
  "Durme"      = c("Durme", "Durmemonding"),
  "Rupel & Nete" = c("Nete", "Rupel", "Rupelmonding"),
  "Zenne"      = c("Zenne", "Rupel"),
  "Dijle"      = c("Dijle", "Rupel"))

```


```{r inladen HIC data}
# 1. Kalibratie per jaar 
df_hic_jaar <- df_hic_raw %>%
  group_by(tijpost, jaar, percentiel) %>%
  summarize(waterstand_HIC_gem = mean(waterstand, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(percentiel == 30) # Target LW30

df_lw_validation_jaar <- sf_data_clean %>%
  left_join(
    df_hic_jaar %>% 
      select(tijpost, jaar, waterstand_HIC_target = waterstand_HIC_gem), 
    by = "tijpost") %>%
  left_join(data_long_lw, by = "AllocNR", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(!tijpost %in% c("Wetteren", "Zwijnaarde Afwaarts", "Zwijnaarde")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(waterstand_HIC_target))

df_lw_validation_jaar <- df_lw_validation_jaar %>% 
  rbind(., df_lw_validation_jaar %>% filter(tijpost == "Hemiksem") %>% mutate(rivier = "Rupel", Dist = -2600)) %>% 
  rbind(., df_lw_validation_jaar %>% filter(tijpost == "Temse") %>% mutate(rivier = "Durme", Dist = -3650)) %>% 
  arrange(Dist)

# 2. Samenvatten over alle jaren
df_hic_summarized <- df_hic_raw %>%
  group_by(tijpost, rivier, fase, percentiel) %>%
  summarise(
    waterstand_HIC_gem = mean(waterstand, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_jaren = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

# 3. Finale Kalibratie dataset (Gemiddelde over 2017-2020)
df_lw_validation <- sf_data_clean %>%
  left_join(
    df_hic_summarized %>% 
      filter(percentiel == 30) %>% 
      select(tijpost, waterstand_HIC_target = waterstand_HIC_gem),
    by = "tijpost") %>%
  left_join(data_long_lw, by = "AllocNR", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(!tijpost %in% c("Wetteren", "Zwijnaarde Afwaarts", "Zwijnaarde")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(waterstand_HIC_target))

df_lw_validation <- df_lw_validation %>% 
  rbind(., df_lw_validation %>% filter(tijpost == "Hemiksem") %>% mutate(rivier = "Rupelmonding", Dist = -2600)) %>% 
  rbind(., df_lw_validation %>% filter(tijpost == "Temse") %>% mutate(rivier = "Durmemonding", Dist = -3650)) %>% 
  arrange(Dist)


```

```{r plot meerdere percentielen}
mijn_lw_plots <- list()

for (naam in names(rivier_groepen)) {
  df_plot <- df_lw_validation %>%
    filter(rivier %in% rivier_groepen[[naam]]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(waterstand_HIC_target)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Dist)) %>%
    mutate(
      Dist_adj = case_when(
        rivier == "Dijle" ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Nete"  ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Zenne" ~ Dist + 11850 + 1250,
        TRUE              ~ Dist),
      LW_raw_fct = as.factor(LW_raw),
      tijpost = fct_reorder(tijpost, Dist_adj))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next

  stations_as <- df_plot %>% distinct(tijpost, Dist_adj) %>% arrange(Dist_adj)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Dist_adj / 1000)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct, group = LW_raw_fct), 
              linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), 
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), 
               color = "red", size = 2, shape = 18) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = stations_as$Dist_adj / 1000, labels = stations_as$tijpost) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 4.5)) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Scaldis LW (%)", option = "D", direction = -1, end = 0.8) + 
    
  theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Kalibratie LW:", naam),
      subtitle = "Blauwgroene punten = Scaldis-model, Rode punten = HIC-meting (LW30)",
      x = "Meetstation", y = "Waterstand (m TAW)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "right")

  if (grepl("Zeeschelde", naam)) p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = 29, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.2)

  print(p)
  mijn_lw_plots[[naam]] <- p
}

```




```{r plot per jaar}
mijn_lw_plots_jaar <- list()

for (naam in names(rivier_groepen)) {
  df_plot <- df_lw_validation_jaar %>%
    filter(rivier %in% rivier_groepen[[naam]]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(waterstand_HIC_target)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Dist)) %>%
    mutate(
      Dist_adj = case_when(
        rivier == "Dijle" ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Nete"  ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Zenne" ~ Dist + 11850 + 1250,
        TRUE              ~ Dist),
      LW_raw_fct = as.factor(LW_raw),
      tijpost = fct_reorder(tijpost, Dist_adj))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next
  stations_as <- df_plot %>% distinct(tijpost, Dist_adj) %>% arrange(Dist_adj)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Dist_adj / 1000)) +
    # Model data
    geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct, group = LW_raw_fct), 
              linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Meting data (Focus op LW30)
    geom_line(data = df_plot %>% filter(LW_raw == 30) %>% group_by(jaar) %>% distinct(tijpost, .keep_all = TRUE), 
              aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = df_plot %>% filter(LW_raw == 30) %>% group_by(jaar) %>% distinct(tijpost, .keep_all = TRUE), 
               aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), color = "red", size = 1.5, shape = 18) +
    
    facet_wrap(~jaar, ncol = 2) + 
    
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = stations_as$Dist_adj / 1000, labels = stations_as$tijpost) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 4.5)) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Scaldis LW (%)", option = "D", direction = -1, end = 0.8) + 
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Kalibratie LW per jaar:", naam),
      subtitle = "Blauwgroene punten = Scaldis-model, Rode punten = HIC-meting (LW30)",
      x = "Meetstation", y = "Waterstand (m TAW)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

  print(p)
  mijn_lw_plots_jaar[[naam]] <- p
}


```


```{r plot kalibratie}
mijn_lw_plots_kalibratie <- list()

for (naam in names(rivier_groepen)) {

  # Filter direct op de gewenste percentielen (5 en 30) binnen de plot-data
  df_plot <- df_lw_validation %>%
    filter(rivier %in% rivier_groepen[[naam]]) %>%
    filter(LW_raw %in% c(10, 30)) %>% ################## <--- De subset stap
    filter(!is.na(waterstand_HIC_target)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Dist)) %>% 
    mutate(
      Dist_adj = case_when(
        rivier == "Dijle" ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Nete"  ~ Dist + 11850,
        rivier == "Zenne" ~ Dist + 11850 + 1250,
        TRUE              ~ Dist),
      LW_raw_fct = as.factor(LW_raw),
      tijpost = fct_reorder(tijpost, Dist_adj))

  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next 

  stations_as <- df_plot %>% distinct(tijpost, Dist_adj) %>% arrange(Dist_adj)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Dist_adj / 1000)) +
    # 1. MODEL: Gestippelde verbindingslijn (LW10 en LW30)
    geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct, group = LW_raw_fct), 
              linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
    # 1b. MODEL: Punten
    geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_WL, color = LW_raw_fct), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    # 2. METING: Zwarte verbindingslijn
    geom_line(aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), 
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    # 3. METING: Rode ruiten (Target LW30)
    geom_point(aes(y = waterstand_HIC_target), 
               color = "red", size = 2, shape = 18) +
    
    # Opmaak
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = stations_as$Dist / 1000, labels = stations_as$tijpost) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 4.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Scaldis LW (%)", values = c("10" = "#053061", "30" = "#4393C3")) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Kalibratie LW:", naam),
      subtitle = "Blauwe punten = Scaldis-model, Rode punten = HIC-meting (LW30)",
      x = "Meetstation", 
      y = "Waterstand (m TAW)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2))

  mijn_lw_plots_kalibratie[[naam]] <- p
  print(p)
}

```


```{r opslaan}

write.csv2(df_lw_validation, paste0(output_dir, "01_LW_output_HIC_Scaldis_vergelijking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

iwalk(mijn_lw_plots, ~ ggsave(file.path(output_fig, paste0("Kalibratie_LW30_gem_", .y, ".png")), .x, width = 8, height = 5))
iwalk(mijn_lw_plots_jaar, ~ ggsave(file.path(output_fig, paste0("Kalibratie_LW30_per_jaar_", .y, ".png")), .x, width = 8, height = 5))
iwalk(mijn_lw_plots_kalibratie, ~ ggsave(file.path(output_fig, paste0("Kalibratie_LW30_ltd_", .y, ".png")), .x, width = 8, height = 5))

```
